title: Give members a dependable reference library

scenes.title: Give members a dependable reference library
scenes.narration: Welcome to Resgrid Academy. In this lesson, we will give members a dependable reference library. Procedures and contacts hidden in individual email threads are difficult to find and keep current. We will explain the features, the setup decisions, and a practical way to check the result.

scenes.title: A department scenario
scenes.narration: A department uploads its standard operating procedures, adds hospital and mutual-aid contacts and creates a medical dispatch protocol. Members find the current procedure, preplan or phone number when they need it instead of searching email. The examples in this series use a fictional department and are teaching scenarios, not default settings.

scenes.title: Contacts
scenes.narration: Contacts. Shared contacts such as hospitals, agencies and vendors. Add the outside contacts members call most.

scenes.title: Documents
scenes.narration: Documents. Shared documents such as procedures and preplans. Upload your most-used documents and organize them by category. Availability also depends on Documents. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Protocols
scenes.narration: Protocols. Dispatch protocols with scripted questions and instructions. Create protocols for the call types that need scripted questions.

scenes.title: New Contact
scenes.narration: New Contact. Add a person or organization contact. Gather the documents and contacts members need most, and decide who keeps them current.

scenes.title: Contact Categories
scenes.narration: Contact Categories. Categories for organizing contacts. Gather the documents and contacts members need most, and decide who keeps them current.

scenes.title: Upload Document
scenes.narration: Upload Document. Upload a document. Gather the documents and contacts members need most, and decide who keeps them current. Availability also depends on Documents. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Notes
scenes.narration: Notes. Short shared notes for the department. Gather the documents and contacts members need most, and decide who keeps them current. Availability also depends on Notes. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: New Note
scenes.narration: New Note. Post a department note. Gather the documents and contacts members need most, and decide who keeps them current. Availability also depends on Notes. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: New Protocol
scenes.narration: New Protocol. Create a dispatch protocol. Gather the documents and contacts members need most, and decide who keeps them current.

scenes.title: Forms
scenes.narration: Forms. Custom forms used on calls and dispatches. Gather the documents and contacts members need most, and decide who keeps them current.

scenes.title: Shared links
scenes.narration: Shared links. Share selected calls, units and personnel with a linked department. Gather the documents and contacts members need most, and decide who keeps them current.

scenes.title: Files and attachments
scenes.narration: Files and attachments. Files attached to documents and records. Gather the documents and contacts members need most, and decide who keeps them current. Availability also depends on Documents. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Connect department profiles and posts
scenes.narration: Connect provides a department profile, posts, and communication surfaces. Review the intended public profile content, then prepare a fictional profile and sample post through their owning screens. Check the visible audience and the published sample content in the demo environment. Confirm availability in the demo department before recording the live workflow.

scenes.title: Search and navigation
scenes.narration: Navigation search helps members find the work they are authorized to access. Search for a known department feature using a member account and an administrator account. Compare the returned navigation options with each account permission scope. Confirm availability in the demo department before recording the live workflow.

scenes.title: Configure one useful workflow
scenes.narration: For the training scenario, work in this order. Step 1. Add key outside contacts and organize categories. Step 2. Upload a current procedure and set its intended visibility. Step 3. Create approved protocol questions or a form for a repeatable dispatch task.

scenes.title: Verify the result
scenes.narration: Now verify the result. Open the contact, document, protocol, and form as an intended member. Check ownership, version currency, attachments, and visibility. A common problem to watch for: A shared link needs an explicit data-sharing review. Keep protocol content aligned with department-approved procedures.

scenes.title: Try it with your department
scenes.narration: Your practice task is simple. Find the hospital contact and current procedure as a sample member. Track outdated material and items without a responsible owner. Record the result, who owns the follow-up, and when it should be reviewed. Use the linked feature scripts for the detailed screen recording plan.
